changes_made.explanation: Added text generation evaluation as a task since the paper evaluates quantization impact on language generation. Added BERT models which are also evaluated. Normalized dataset names to standard forms.
Removed duplicate 'perplexity (PPL)' since 'Perplexity' already covers it. Used standard capitalization for metrics.
No LLMs were used as judges/evaluators in this paper - only for quantization and generation tasks.
No human evaluations were conducted in this paper - only automatic metrics were used.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on model quantization methods rather than direct NLG evaluation. The NLG aspect comes from evaluating how quantization affects language modeling performance. The extraction was generally accurate but missed some key models and clarified the nature of the NLG evaluation being indirect (quantization impact on generation quality).
